definitions.explanation: Said of a tool, device, service, or interface that works smoothly and takes little effort or learning. Formed from {使|つか}う plus the suffix 〜やすい (easy to ...).

examples.japanese: このアプリは{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: This app is easy to use.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}いやすい{道具|どうぐ}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose tools that are easy to use.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいサイトは{前|まえ}より{使|つか}いやすくなったと{評判|ひょうばん}だ。
examples.english: People say the new site has become easier to use than before.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使|つか}いやすい{道具|どうぐ}: an easy-to-use tool
- {使|つか}いやすさ: usability (noun form)
- {使|つか}いやすくなる: to become easier to use
- {使|つか}いやすいように{並|なら}べる: to arrange things for easy use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {使|つか}いにくい: hard to use — the direct opposite
- {便利|べんり}: convenient — about overall usefulness, not about ease of operation
- {分|わ}かりやすい: easy to understand — about comprehension rather than handling

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {使|つか}いやすくなかったら
